94	## 5. Decisions
95	
96	### Decision D1
97	- Basis: R1, R2, R3, R4
98	- Minimal option: a comment on the constants asking not to edit a version
99	- Selected option: a golden digest per version, recorded once, checked by the build
100	- Rationale: the rule was already known and was broken three times in one afternoon; a comment is not read at the moment a sentence is added, a failing build is
101	- Consequences: a text change takes a new version, its digest is recorded once and the earlier version keeps rendering
102	- Falsifier: a change to the text of a published version that the build accepts
103	
104	## 6. Validation
105	
106	### Strategy
107	
108	The test was written, then a sentence of `review-brief/4` was edited to see it fail with the message naming the version, and reverted to see it pass.
109	
110	### Deterministic checks
111	
112	`go test` of the tests named in the trace; the strict matrix in a clean clone.
113	
114	### Requirement trace
115	- R1 [satisfied] test:TestEveryReviewBriefTemplateVersionRendersWhatItRenderedWhenItWasPublished check:review-brief-templates-are-immutable-integration
116	- R2 [satisfied] test:TestEveryReviewBriefTemplateVersionRendersWhatItRenderedWhenItWasPublished
117	- R3 [satisfied] test:TestEveryReviewBriefTemplateVersionRendersWhatItRenderedWhenItWasPublished
118	- R4 [satisfied] test:TestEveryReviewBriefTemplateVersionRendersWhatItRenderedWhenItWasPublished
119	- R5 [satisfied] test:TestTheDigestSeesEverySectionOfEveryVariant
120	
121	### Known gaps
122	- The versioned handoff renderers (`delegation_handoff.go`) and the adjudication and smoke templates sign text under a version name too and are not covered; the follow-up below names them.
123	- A recorded version that is removed from the list of earlier templates fails the test, and the recording refuses to overwrite a digest file it cannot read or parse.
124	- The adjudication and smoke templates are not covered: their versions did not change under one name, and they render from scripts and questions the fixed bundle does not carry.
125	- The digest of `review-brief/4` is the text as it renders today; the two earlier texts it had before are not recorded and are not needed, since a done scope's approval is verified as sealed.
126	- The recording is made with `UPDATE_BRIEF_GOLDEN=1` and keeps every digest already in the file; changing one by hand is visible in review.
127	
128	---
129	
130	## 7. Final Report
131	
132	### Delivered scope
133	Each review brief template version in use has a digest of what it renders from a fixed bundle, recorded in `testdata/review_brief_template_digests.json`; the build fails when a version renders other text, saying that a change takes a new version, and when a version has no digest; recording never rewrites a digest already there. Left out: the adjudication and smoke templates.
134	
135	### Files and modules changed
136	- pose-mcp/internal/pose (review_brief_versions_test.go, testdata/review_brief_template_digests.json)
137	- POSE.md and its pt-BR and scaffold copies; the validation matrix gains `review-brief-templates-are-immutable-integration`
138	
139	### Validation executed
140	- Command: `pose validate --strict --jobs 4` on a clean clone of the reviewed head, and the suites of `internal/pose`
141	- Result: recorded by the sealed validation evidence; independent delegated review (Claude Opus 5.5, independent by model) concluded with `pose review conclude`.
142	
143	### Residual risks
144	- A text change that also changes the version constants and the digests in one commit passes by design: the guard asks for a new version, not for a reviewer.
145	
146	### Follow-ups
147	
148	- [open] Cover the adjudication and smoke brief templates and the versioned delegation handoff renderers with the same golden digests, rendered from a fixed script, fixed questions and a fixed predecessor run. (owner:@pose-maintainers crit:low review:2027-01-08)
